_meta.section: Spiritual Gems Q2 — open / share any spiritual gem

notes.content: Look at the very last words of Isaiah 58:9 — 'Here I am.' We usually picture US calling out to Jehovah, like a kid calling for a parent. But notice — this verse flips it. WE call out, then JEHOVAH responds — 'Here I am.' That's the same phrase Samuel used when Jehovah called him as a boy in 1 Samuel 3. Same posture, same readiness — but here, the parent is the one saying it to the kid. Jehovah is the one ready to be called on. Not waiting to be impressed. Not waiting to be earned. Just ready. 'Here I am.' That's how he answers.

underlines.phrase: you will cry for help, and he will say, ‘Here I am!’
